[Act: limitation
 Chapter: First Division · Part VII · Suits Relating to Tort
 Section: 81::One year.
]


By executors, administrators or representatives under the Legal Representatives’ Suits Act, 1855 (12 of 1855).
Period of limitationOne year.
Time from which period begins to runThe date of the death of the person wronged.
